title: TV Sarawak (TVS) 2026 — Sponsorship & Spot Buy
summary: 30-second TVC RM1,800 fringe / RM3,600 prime; sponsor formats from RM600, naming rights RM18k, special reports RM9k.
description: TV Sarawak (TVS) 2026 sponsorship and spot-buy rate card (23 pages). TVC 10–60 seconds: fringe RM600–RM3,600, prime RM1,200–RM7,200; 30-second spot is RM1,800 fringe and RM3,600 prime. Sponsorship formats: breaker in/out RM1,200–2,400, L-shape RM9,000–12,000, lower third RM7,200–10,800, info-capsule RM7,200–14,400, animated bug RM3,600–7,200, clock face RM1,200–1,800, YouTube countdown RM1,800, end credit RM600–1,200, logo placement RM1,800–3,600, naming rights RM9,000–18,000, special report RM9,000 prime, host mention RM600–2,400, guest appearance RM4,000–25,000, sponsored content RM3,000–9,000, crawler RM2,700–4,500, product placement RM3,600–25,200, competitor disallowance RM1,800–10,800, premium placement RM3,600–10,800 and brand participation RM1,800–3,600. Fringe is 12:01am–5:59pm, prime is 6pm–12am; rates exclude applicable tax. TVS Profile (updated 15 October 2026): 11.7M unique reach and 172.8M total views on Nielsen (Peninsular, Jan–Sep 2026); 7.3M reach and 103.6M views via Fifty5Blue; 3.73M social followers with 1.46B social views; 3.05M website visitors; TVS Inspire OTT app at 72.8K lifetime downloads. News belt: TVS Pagi 7am, TVS Tengahari 12pm, Utama 740 7:40pm, TVS Nightline 10:30pm, plus Berita Iban, Rebao, Berita Wilayah and Detik Dunia. 2025 live coverage totalled 126 events and 366.9M linear-plus-digital viewers.
